issues.detail: The small fairway patch beside G1 appears uniformly green rather than showing clear alternating stripes across its footprint.
issues.consequence: In the overview, this mapped fairway section may read as unstriped turf or another green-like patch instead of fairway.

review.reason: The course layout, mapped water, greens, tees, and walking connectors appear faithful, and the greens read as continuous natural surfaces. The small Hole 1 fairway patch lacks clearly visible alternating mowing stripes at thumbnail scale.

issues.detail: A beige walking path branches from the G1-to-T2 connector toward T1; that branch is not mapped.
issues.consequence: The overview depicts an extra walking connection that is not part of the approved diagram.

issues.detail: The mapped walking connector from G2 to T3 is not shown continuously; the short path near T3 stops well short of G2.
issues.consequence: The overview leaves the mapped transfer between these holes unclear.

issues.detail: The small detached fairway patch beside G1 lacks clearly visible edge-to-edge alternating mowing stripes at thumbnail scale.
issues.consequence: The patch is harder to distinguish as fairway in the course overview.

review.reason: The putting greens read as single natural surfaces and the overall wooded style is coherent, but the illustration adds a walking-path branch, does not show the mapped G2-to-T3 connector, and leaves the small mapped fairway near G1 without clearly visible mowing stripes.
